title: Appointed as Assistant
original: I've never been an assistant before. It's a novel experience, but rest assured that I will not be remiss, even if this work is not my forte.

title: Talk 1
original: If any children aboard Rhodes Island wish to learn piano, you may send them to me, but I am a strict teacher. I am not one to release a student partway once he begins his studies.

title: Talk 2
original: I hear a musical school known as 'jazz' is currently popular in Columbia. I've had the fortune to hear a few records. The free, unweighted playing style greatly amuses me, but sadly, I seem to lack the temperament for performing in such a swing.

title: Talk 3
original: Are you curious about my hands? Indeed, they're broader than others' at a glance. Please, they're no freakish things. I have them to thank that I can rain every melodie that swims in my head down onto the keys.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: The Infected are only comparatively freer in Leithanien, and not that free. Outside of the Afterglow, there was hardly anywhere I could live, or eat... there was almost nowhere to turn.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My near-death experience unleashed a sudden, completely new melodie upon my mind. Compared to it, the musical forms I'd once learnt seemed like shackles. Just what tremendous feeling brought about its birth? Perhaps in the face of Death, I was nowhere near as fearless as I imagined.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Thank you for your concern. I'm not feeling ill—my writing is merely bottlenecked, and I haven't slept in several days. My hair, well... I often unconsciously grab at it while composing, if that explains its current unruliness.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Doctor, would you like to exercise with me? You seem surprised. Fräulein Hibiscus requested it. Most artists are the frail sort, but my recitals often exceed two hours in length. How could I handle it without a sturdy physique to support me?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: You flatter me. So many voices have been snuffed out in the rapids of history. Their owners were hardly without talent; they simply left too soon, before anyone could stop and listen to their masterpieces fine as nature's song. And I was but slightly luckier, enough so to escape with my life.

title: Idle
original: Asleep? I hardly expected the lullabies I wrote to have an actual effect on you...

title: Onboard
original: Greetings, Doctor, my name is Czerny. Any charm or taste I may have had has been poured entirely into my compositions. And as for myself, I am no more than a run-of-the-mill performer. That's all the introduction you need.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I will commit to watching these as you require, but this is hardly how I prefer to study. I have always approached others' second-hand experiences with skepticism.

title: Promotion 1
original: I'm extremely grateful for your sponsorship, Doctor; I am currently struggling financially. The annals of Leithanian art will commemorate your giving.

title: Promotion 2
original: I thank you for your approval. I had never seriously pursued Originium Arts before, and I hope henceforth that my Arts may be cast as freely as my melodien.

title: Added to Squad
original: Through my creations, both pain and joy become immortal.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Compared to my piano, my ability with a baton actually fares quite well.

title: Depart
original: I've finished tuning. I may perform now.

title: Begin Operation
original: Please be seated.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Shall I open?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Shall I close?

title: Deployment 1
original: To tremble in my music is your honor.

title: Deployment 2
original: Extraordinary melodies can only be played by the soul that quakes.

title: In Battle 1
original: Silence, immediately!

title: In Battle 2
original: Listen or leave!

title: In Battle 3
original: Shut up or else!

title: In Battle 4
original: Get out! Right now!

title: 4-star Result
original: Huff... I may be—exceptionally tired in both body and mind, but I do not want the music to end here.

title: 3-star Result
original: Drawing the final barline here is perfect. I hardly want any movement of mine to approach tedium.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: There are times when stubborn pursuit of a technique hinders more than helps. Allowing your emotion to follow the music's natural flow can take you further.

title: Operation Failure
original: Please, don't be disheartened. Not every composition is smooth from start to finish. There'll always be a few rounds of polish before you land where you want to.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: The deck of this ship is very spacious. Have you ever considered holding a concert there?

title: Tap
original: Watch that the noten in my pocket don't spill out.

title: Trust Tap
original: Perhaps you like to try learning an instrument? I could teach you; I'm qualified to tutor for the majority of them.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Forgive me for turning down your invitation to perform. Even the most assiduous musician wouldn't want to work on this day, and besides, the fineness of it needs no musical dressing. The laughs of passersby and the clinking of table glasses have answered well enough, no?

title: Greeting
original: I've written a new song. Would you like to hear?

title: Birthday
original: I've reserved some tickets to a performance of a symphony, all fine VIP seats. If you're free on the day, you must attend. Ah, yes, I wish you a happy birthday.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: To dance to music is a rare moment of liberty for the Infected. Doctor, would there be more dancing, more free souls, if I were to write more myself?
